newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 22.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 22.

text.p: * Xerox Corp reported first quarter earnings per diluted share of $0.75, up from $0.65 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.70. The stock closed at 58-5/8 Friday.
* Texaco Inc is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $1.73, up from $1.42 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares were up 5/8 at 105 in London.
* Consolidated Edison Co of New York is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $0.77, compared to $0.78 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 28-1/8 Monday.
* Lincoln National Corp reported first quarter earnings per operating share of $1.14, compared to $0.91 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $1.05. Shares closed at 52-1/8.
* Knight-Ridder Inc reported first quarter earnings per operating share of $0.49, up from $0.24 last year. The First Call estimate was $0.47. Shares closed at 36-1/2.
* Allstate Corp is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $1.17, compared to $0.76 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 61-5/8.
